new_results.name: Turaev_H_level
new_results.verdict: H(ii) proof only needs a smooth pi1-surjective disk after Lemmas 7.2-7.3; therefore it cannot obstruct KDG, already handle-ribbon/homotopy-ribbon

new_results.name: Suzuki_plain_parallel
new_results.verdict: Theorem 2.2 is identical for ribbon and boundary links; zero-framed parallels are boundary links, so the condition is automatic on all plain KDG parallels

reason_no_computation: Both proposed tests are structurally forced to pass on KDG/plain parallels; computation would not discriminate ribbonness.
exact_gap: KDG still needs a global proof that no unlink derivative exists on any Seifert surface, including stabilizations, or another invariant that is genuinely ribbon-only beyond the known handle-ribbon disk.
next_action: Seek a stable unlink-derivative obstruction for KDG; colored-Jones work is secondary and only worth resuming after specifying a non-boundary ribbon-preserving multi-component pattern.
